title: Diagonal subsequence along which ∫ f dμ_j converges for every f ∈ C_c(X) (sequential, erratum-corrected Alaoglu step of Simon 4.16)
statement: Let X be a locally compact Hausdorff second-countable space with its Borel σ-algebra and μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) measures on X such that for every compact K ⊆ X there is C_K < ∞ with μ_j(K) ≤ C_K for all sufficiently large j. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every continuous compactly supported f : X → ℝ the real sequence (∫ f dμ_{φ(j)})_{j∈ℕ} converges.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : ℕ → Measure X), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ j K ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μ (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 L)
